test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 5
 3
 6
 
 

 11
 7
 14
 
 

 ?
 20
 40
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58166ba598806c56de204b69e9bae9d47a29deb444e1e2f26edd363675d94611.png] 

⇒ __(3 + 7)__ × 2 = 20

⇒ __10 × 2__ = 20

⇒ 20 = 20 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cda831eeccc1129cfad2d52c8014004aa3e31a03816af5e0679b537f99e3b2f.png] 

⇒ __(6 + 14)__ × 2 = 40

⇒ __20 × 2__ = 40

⇒ 40 = 40 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e51f50a5db08391d1ed7b60bef3c0d00331bf85b71cdcb78f498a058b0aeb817.png] 

⇒ __(5 + 11)__ × 2 = ?

⇒ __16 × 2__ = ?

⇒ 32 = ?

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
